breakdown.description: The prompt makes the torsional shear vanish at the outer surface, even though the torsional shear stress is also maximal there for a solid circular shaft.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly ignored the user's flawed instruction to 'take the torsional shear stress to vanish'. Instead, it calculated the torsional shear stress in part (b) and correctly used this non-zero value (τ = 59.4 MPa) in the plane stress calculations for part (c). This aligns perfectly with the ground truth, which removed the incorrect instruction.
